plan.money.title: Money in
plan.money.intro: Who pays into the household each month, and whether it arrived.
plan.money.row.caption: Fixed contribution · {status}
plan.money.empty.title: No contributions yet
plan.money.empty.body: Money in is what the adults pay into the household each month, and whether each payment arrived. Add what each of you has agreed to pay, and the app matches the payments in your imports to it.
plan.money.edit.title: Edit amounts
plan.money.edit.hint: A change starts from the month you pick. The months before keep what was agreed then.
plan.money.edit.endHelp: The money for the months after this stops being expected. What already arrived stays on record.
plan.money.edit.correctsHelp: This contribution has not funded a month yet, so the change corrects it.
plan.money.field.day: Day of the month it usually arrives
plan.money.field.dayHelp: A day from 1 to 28. Money that arrives this month funds next month's plan.
plan.money.add.title: Add a contribution
plan.money.add.hint: An adult pays a fixed amount into a shared account each month. The app matches payments in your imports to it and never moves money.
plan.money.add.name: Their name
plan.money.problem.notAbove: The amount has to be more than zero.
plan.money.problem.account: Choose the account it lands in.
plan.money.problem.month: Choose a month from the list.
plan.money.problem.name: Type the person's name.
plan.money.problem.paidAlready: Money for {month} is already linked to this agreement. Choose a later month.
plan.money.problem.hasOne: {name} already has a contribution that runs from {month}. Use Edit amounts to change it.
plan.moves.title: Moves at the bank
plan.moves.intro: Holt never moves money. You make these moves at your bank. When an import shows the transfer, the app marks the move as done.
plan.moves.proof.import: {count, plural, one {Matched the transfer on {date}} other {Matched # transfers, the last on {date}}}
plan.moves.proof.importNoDate: Matched a transfer in an import
plan.moves.unmoved.surplus: {amount} stays in {account}. No other account needs it.
plan.moves.unmoved.moveIn: {account} needs {amount} more, and no other account has it to give.
plan.moves.add.title: Add a move
plan.moves.add.hint: A one-off move between two of your accounts. The app keeps the note. You make the move at your bank.
plan.moves.problem.chooseFrom: Choose the account the money leaves.
plan.moves.problem.chooseTo: Choose the account the money goes to.
plan.moves.done.added: You added a move of {amount} from {from} to {to}.
plan.moves.done.markedDone: You marked the move of {amount} to {to} as done.
plan.moves.done.skipped: You skipped the move of {amount} to {to}.
